text: Prices are great . But make sure you read ALL the fine print. And a lot of times they slaughter you on the cost of shipping.... especially if you are getting something at a great deal. text: all good so far. I've bought a few things now & everything arrived sooner then expected. cheap prices. Don't trust the silver or gold jewellery as it's not real. text: Wish is nearly perfect. Every store I've used is excellent and professional with great products at great prices! I did rate Wish low on "wish lists". I haven't found anyway to make a wish list. Have to put what I want to save in the cart...then if I want to buy something, and don't want a saved item at that time I have to delete the saved item to place my order. Then look it up again to put back in the cart. That's a pain. Needs at least a way to save an item in the cart for later.
author: Connie Cook

text: Fun. Lots of products for a great price. But you get what you pay for. Be sure to read the description of the product. Wish has started to charge more for shipping and yet the time is the same. Order 1 or more of the same item and they double the shipping. I bought a mini tablet cooling fan for $3 & cost $6 for shipping. Plus the tax it came $12. Wish was much better 2 years ago.
author: Matt Gothard

text: Great selection of products for less. Shipping costs are on the high side, much higher than the product you are buying most of the time. I have a membership, so some items are shipped for free. I think having to pay $5.99 a month for membership should get you free shipping on EVERYTHING but it doesn't. Items arrive quicker than they used to, which is always a plus. If you don't get the exact product you order, color, design etc, you get a refund on it which I love. It has only happened 1 time.
author: Becky Eaton

text: Great stuff at affordable prices, but you just gotta read the descriptions well. I ordered what I thought were Gel pens once, but got only refills. Product had a misleading photo of a package of gel pens, not a photo of the refills only, like the most recent refills I purchased. The better merchants won't try to get you to buy something by deceiving you, but YOU have to do YOUR part and read all the details and in depth descriptions. Overall, love this app.
author: Joy

text: Nice discount app, with what seems to be quality products... UPDATE: Shipping costs have become ridiculous now!!!! You're basically paying the same price in shipping as you do for the product. If an item is $20 expect to pay close to $20 in shipping, for each item, regardless if they ship them together. What was a nice app of knock-offs at discount prices is becoming an app with knock-offs at name brand prices😕 As if supporting China wasn't already hard enough

text: Very upset as 47 pounds is alot of money for me and all 5 items which were in my basket but I never ordered as I moved out from the address on the app. I don't know how it happened, but I would not order to the address I had no access too. text: Prices not as advertised! Every time you click on an item, the price increases significantly. More recently, I've noticed most items are marked as out of stock. All purchases will end up as a guaranteed disappointment, so save your money!

text: Have been using Wish for many years now. People complaining about the hidden "shipping cost", you can always just look it up before adding the item to your cart, and ask yourself, if that's the price you're willing to pay. I only had less than a handful of items that were lost or arrived either damaged, but after speaking with customer service, they refunded my items with no issues. Now as for the quality of the items, i would say 90% of it, is as described. Do your research before committing

Last week Unauthorized Purchases were made over $150 . Cancelled card/deactivated account. Take caution. No more wish for me.

text: If you want to be charged hundreds of dollars for things you DID NOT order, then be told upon complaining that someone will probably contact you in a week or two, then this is the app for you! text: Its really fun looking at all of the different things they offer. It doesn't matter what you search for they have it.. furniture, clothing, toys, gadjets, electronics, makeup, cologne, perfume, animal supplies, baby stuff, cleaning items, storage items, kitchen items, lighting, outdoor and indoor decor, bathroom stuff, swimming accessories and swimming toys, jewelry for men and women, items for couples only, gag gifts, and much much more.. things you didn't even know you could buy or ever think to look for. There are a few things to be mindful of though, first, never jump on the first price you see because about 50 more sellers are offering the same thing for less and always check the shipping details so you know how much the shipping costs because that varies by seller as well. In addition, always look at every picture the item has and check other sellers pictures and find a seller that has customer reviews with their own pictures because the sellers pictures almost always make the item look much much bigger than it actually is. Customer photos don't lie. The next thing to be mindful of is your delivery time. 8 out 10 sellers are from over seas, so when you see multiple reviews about how fast something was delivered or it says arrived early, the majority of those comments, in my opinion are not real because those phrases are excessively used by some customer with a profile name and they usually don't have a picture attached and when you click on their wish customer profile page, they don't really have any info about themselves, their orders, or the review that was under the item you were looking at. That being said, DO NOT PAY EXTRA FOR THE FAST DELIVERY BECAUSE IT IS NOT GUARANTEED AND YOU DON'T GET A REFUND WHEN IT DOESN'T ARRIVE BY THE DATE IT ORIGINALLY SAID.., also about the shipping time, don't order something that you need delivered quickly. Give it at least a month. I have gotten quite a few things within a 2 to 3 week time frame, but I have had it take longer. Lastly, check out the sellers customer rating. It really matters. If they don't have a very positive rating, find that item with a different seller by simply scrolling over to the heading titled Related.
